sn35.33:1.3: “Bhikkhus, all is subject to birth. And what, bhikkhus, is the all that is subject to birth?
sn35.33:1.4: The eye is subject to birth.
sn35.33:1.9: Whatever feeling arises with eye-contact as condition … that too is subject to birth.
sn35.33:1.17: The mind … Whatever feeling arises with mind-contact as condition … that too is subject to birth.
sn35.33:1.18: “Seeing thus, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple experiences revulsion towards the eye, towards forms, towards eye-consciousness, towards eye-contact …
sn35.33:1.19: He understands: ‘… there is no more for this state of being.’”
sn35.42:1.1: All is subject to cessation….” Each is to be completed as above.
